High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Royal Guard]] (Death Star II, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Death Star II/Death Star II Dark/Royal Guard.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeVmZIWnl3Tm5Rdm8/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Royal Guard.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,352 bytes, SHA-256 <code>534afe9c03a2d42a18b399f976e717d1f95b8a6a53a0cfa66fc3a0f95599b2dc</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

{{HiRez scan note}}

The regular archival face of this card on its article stays [[:File:DS2-D-royalguard-decipher-archive.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.
